import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw) {
        String s = sc.next();
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        int n = s.length();
        boolean atReplaced = false;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            if (i == 0) {
                res.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (!atReplaced && i <= n - 3 && i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                res.append('@');
                atReplaced = true;
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            if (i <= n - 4 && i + 2 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                res.append('.');
                i += 3;
                continue;
            }
            res.append(s.charAt(i));
            i++;
        }
        pw.print(res.toString());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve(sc, pw);
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
